$comment: The API changelog (public-api: The changelog page and the release notes). A pull request that announces something about the API adds a dated entry under unreleased: a breaking change released without notice, allowed only for an urgent security fix, needs the api-breaking label, an entry of kind breaking and a bump of info.version in openapi/v1.json (public-api: The `api-breaking` label for urgent security fixes). Before the packet schema is published, a breaking packet change needs the api-breaking label and an entry of kind breaking with "schemas": ["packet"], dated the day it is announced, and no release contains it until 14 days later (handoff-packet: Breaking packet changes before publication). Entries are shown with the release that carries them, on /docs/api/changelog and in the release notes.
